scope: Issue body/comments/timeline; current repository metadata/default head/package/root listing; up to 100 open PRs per repository; direct current details for timeline/comment-linked PRs
limitations: No reproductions executed; reported behavior remains independent-verification candidate.
No clones, installs, tests, code implementation, harness edits, or public communication.
Open status is point-in-time. Absence of linked work is not proof that unlinked/private work does not exist.
Repository pushes alone may be dependency automation; low-activity flags are retained.
